description: A soft link that has run past the maximum session time is closed with Soft Link Terminated to share channel while U_PDUs for another node wait for a link, and that node is then called.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0; cas.max_links is 1. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215); the SIS of the called node declares the soft link established (A-0194), knowing from C_PHYSICAL_LINK_MADE that it is the called node (A-0325). sis.soft_link_max/0.0.1.3 starts with 40000, to 97550 (A-0014, A-0015, A-0322); the minimum hold is set to 0, so none runs, and the idle time to 3600000, so sis.soft_link_idle/0.0.1.3 starts but never falls due here (A-0320, A-0326). At 61000 the peer's first DATA C_PDU arrives, a DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) with 'ping' for SAP 9, which no client has bound, so the SIS discards it (A-0235); cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403). At 62000 the burst ends with an acknowledgement owed: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and 12000 ms of contention; at 78000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, 15 bytes, 1 block) goes out, ending at 83550. At 85000 conn 1 sends an ARQ U_PDU 'wait' (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.4, TTL 0): there is no soft link to 0.0.1.4, so the SIS holds it and asks for a physical link (A-0008, A-0193), and the CAS refuses locally with Maximum Physical Links In Use, the one link being in use (B-0025, B-0402), with no output; the SIS holds off (B-0028). The link to 0.0.1.3 is within its maximum session time, and carries nothing of lower priority (A-0323), so it stays. At 97550 sis.soft_link_max/0.0.1.3 expires while the U_PDU for 0.0.1.4 is held off, so the SIS closes the link with Soft Link Terminated to share channel (A-0014, A-0205, A-0322). Nothing is outstanding and no acknowledgement is owed, so the link is clean and the CAS goes straight to Step 1 with no PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST (B-0278, B-0317, B-0421): link_state breaking, then LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074) and contention. PHYSICAL LINK BREAK goes out at 145550 with reason 0, as B-0302 maps a share channel close (octet 40), our C_PDU ID 1; cas.break from 151100. At 161000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM: cas.break stops and link_state unlinked (B-0286). A link has closed, so the held-off peer asks again (B-0028, B-0412): the Caller procedure starts towards 0.0.1.4, link_state calling (B-0202). The burst ends at 162000 with the request queued: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then 36000 ms of contention; PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4, our C_PDU ID 2) goes out at 202000 and cas.link_request/0.0.1.4 starts when it ends at 207550 (B-0203, B-0400). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10 for 1 block to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node), 0.0.1.3 and 0.0.1.4 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
